mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 55% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC drops below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1200.0 and RSAFS < 500000.0 in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint declines in HOUST and RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal's Rank IC remains below -0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling economic slowdown and reduced corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal's Rank IC is above -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5%, the market anticipates a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal's Rank IC is above -0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 510,000 million dollars, combined with rising GDP growth (GDPC1), signals strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during joint RSAFS > 510000.0 and GDPC1 > 18700.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% and decline in non-farm payrolls below 150,000 indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 150000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal's Rank IC is above -0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 104.0, combined with a drop in housing starts below 1200.0, indicates a supply-side shock that disrupts production and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint INDPRO < 104.0 and HOUST < 1200.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal's Rank IC is above -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
